mentions.name: TheOpenPresenter
mentions.description: An open-source tool for displaying content on TVs and screens, supporting slide decks, dashboards, games, and other custom content, with a quick demo accessible by scanning a QR code on the landing page.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on what I'm envisioning will be the one-stop shop of showing things to your TVs/screens. Whether that's slide decks, dashboards, games, and whatever you can imagine.
